description: Database credentials committed in the shapes AI-built apps actually use: a MERN config/db.js passing a MongoDB Atlas mongodb+srv:// string to mongoose.connect, a Supabase postgresql:// pooler string in a pg Pool, Sequelize's generated config/config.json with real passwords, and a mysql2 pool with the password on its own line. The original rule caught none of them (it needed a connection/database/db word before the URL on the same line, and a host on the same line as the password). VC049 must fire on each.
